name: Jira
tagline: Atlassian's work tracking tool for planning, tracking and releasing software with boards, backlogs and timelines.
bestFor: Software teams running Scrum or Kanban
description: Jira tracks work items on Scrum and Kanban boards, backlogs, lists, timelines and calendars, with rule-based automation and built-in time logging. The Free plan covers up to 10 users, and Standard costs $9.70 per user per month on monthly billing.
pros: Free plan for up to 10 users with 2 GB of storage and 150 automation steps per month
Rovo Search, Chat and Agents are included on every paid plan (25, 70 or 150 credits per user per month)
Monthly per-user price is graduated and drops above 100 users (Standard $8.20 for users 101-250)
Integrations with 3,000+ tools listed on the pricing page
cons: The Free plan does not include Rovo AI
No built-in wiki; Confluence is a separate Atlassian product
SSO, SCIM and Active Directory sync require a separate Atlassian Guard Standard subscription
freePlanDetails: Free forever for up to 10 users, 2 GB file storage, 150 automation steps per subscription per month, community support. Rovo AI not included.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 10 users, 2 GB storage, 150 automation steps per month, community support.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Monthly: $9.70 per user for users 1-100, then graduated ($8.20 for 101-250, $6.85 for 251-1,000). Annual is sold in user bands: $950/year for up to 10 users (about $7.92 per user per month); $9,700/year for 51-100 users. 250 GB storage, 400 automation steps per user per month, 25 Rovo credits per user per month, 9/5 regional support. Up to 100,000 users per site. Prices from Atlassian's catalog dated 13-10-2026.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Monthly: $19.60 per user for users 1-100, then graduated ($14.65 for 101-250). Annual: $1,950/year for up to 10 users (about $16.25 per user per month). Unlimited storage, 750 automation steps per user per month, 70 Rovo credits per user per month, cross-team planning, 24/7 support for critical issues, 99.9% uptime SLA.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales; listed for 801 to 100,000 users. 1,000 automation steps per user per month, 150 Rovo credits per user per month, multiple sites (up to 150), data residency, 24/7 support for all issues, 99.95% uptime SLA.

integrations: 3,000+ integrations; Rovo MCP Server connects Jira to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code

sources.label: Jira pricing page (incl. embedded plan catalog and Rovo FAQ)
Atlassian support: log time on a work item

name: Wrike
tagline: Work management platform with Gantt charts, dashboards, request forms and AI agents for cross-team projects.
bestFor: Mid-size and enterprise teams managing cross-department workflows
description: Wrike combines task and project management with board, table and interactive Gantt views, dashboards and AI features, with resource planning and budgeting on higher tiers. A Free plan is available, and the Team plan costs $10 per user per month billed annually.
pros: Team plan includes AI Essentials (AI content and editing, comment summaries, board AI, natural-language automation rule generation)
Interactive Gantt charts and shareable dashboards from the $10 Team plan
SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001:2013, ISO 27018:2019 and CSA STAR listed
Option to host data in Wrike's EU data center in Paris
cons: Business and higher plans are sold only as annual subscriptions, and no monthly-billing price is published for Team
Time tracking is listed only from the custom-priced Pinnacle plan
Seats are sold in groups of five for accounts up to 30 seats
freePlanDetails: Free: web, desktop and mobile apps, project and task management, board and table views. No user, storage or task limits are stated on the pricing page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Project and task management, board and table views; no AI listed.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per user per month, billed annually; 2 to 15 users. AI Essentials, shareable dashboards, interactive Gantt charts. No monthly-billing price published. Seats sold in groups of five up to 30 seats.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per user per month, annual subscription only; 5 to 200 users. Starter pack of AI Elite actions, templates, standard integration.

plans.name: Pinnacle
plans.notes: Contact sales. 3x more AI Elite actions, advanced resource and capacity planning with time tracking, budgeting, advanced reporting and BI.

plans.name: Apex
plans.notes: Contact sales. 10x more AI Elite actions, unlimited Whiteboards, Wrike Integrate and Wrike Sync included. Pricing valid for new purchases on or after January 21, 2026.

integrations: Wrike Integrate (no-code automations, add-on) and Wrike Two-Way Sync with 22 systems (add-on); both included in Apex

name: Basecamp
tagline: 37signals' flat-priced project management app with to-dos, message boards, card tables, chat and docs in each project.
bestFor: Small businesses and agencies that want flat pricing with no per-user fees
description: Basecamp puts to-dos, message boards, Kanban-style card tables, chat, calendars and docs and files inside each project, with a cross-project timeline called the Lineup. A free one-project plan is available, and paid packages start at $29 per month flat for up to 5 users.
pros: Flat package prices with no per-user fees; Pro Unlimited includes unlimited users for $199 per month billed annually
Every package includes message boards, to-dos, card tables, chat, calendar, docs and files, and automatic check-ins
ChatGPT and Claude AI connectors with MCP support included on every package, including Free
Free for K-12, homeschool and university class work; 10% off for registered 501(c)(3) nonprofits
cons: Time tracking only on Pro Plus ($99/month) and Pro Unlimited
Freelancer, Pro and Pro Plus cap active projects (3, 8 and 12) and users (5, 10 and 15)
No Gantt chart or rule-based automations listed
freePlanDetails: One project at a time, 1 GB storage, up to 3 users; no templates, multiple tools per project or time tracking. No credit card required.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 project, 1 GB storage, 3 users max.

plans.name: Freelancer
plans.notes: Flat $29 per month for the whole account (not per user), up to 5 users. 3 active projects, 10 GB storage, 24/7/365 support. No templates, multiple tools per project, time tracking or annual billing.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Flat $79 per month, up to 10 users. 8 active projects, 25 GB storage, multiple tools per project, project templates. No time tracking or annual billing.

plans.name: Pro Plus
plans.notes: Flat $99 per month, up to 15 users. 12 active projects, 100 GB storage, time tracking. No annual billing.

plans.name: Pro Unlimited
plans.notes: Flat $199 per month billed annually for the whole account; unlimited users and projects, 1 TB storage (extra 1 TB for $50/month), enhanced admin controls, priority 24/7/365 support, personalized onboarding. Annual billing by check, ACH, wire or card. Note: the pricing page FAQ still mentions $329/month for Pro Unlimited, which conflicts with the listed $199.

integrations: ChatGPT and Claude AI connectors with MCP support; bring-your-own AI agents via CLI
support: Priority 24/7/365 support and personalized onboarding (Pro Unlimited)

sources.label: Basecamp features page (Lineup, Hill Charts, Docs & Files)

name: Smartsheet
tagline: Spreadsheet-style work management platform with Gantt, board, calendar and timeline views, automations and dashboards.
bestFor: Teams that plan projects in spreadsheet-style sheets
description: Smartsheet manages projects in spreadsheet-style sheets with Gantt, table, board and calendar views, automated workflows, forms, reports and dashboards, plus built-in AI tools. There is no free plan; Pro costs $9 per member per month billed yearly or $12 billed monthly.
pros: AI tools (Smart Assist, Smart Columns, AI dashboard builder, formula generation) included on every plan
Unlimited free Contributors on Pro and unlimited Guests from Business
Business includes unlimited automations, timeline view, workload tracking and 1 TB of storage
Lists SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 42001 and FedRAMP
cons: No free plan; only a 30-day trial
Pro is capped at 10 Members, has 250 automations per month and no timeline view, and is only available to new customers
Time and expense tracking needs the Resource Management add-on, which is not available on Pro

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per Member per month; 1-10 Members, unlimited Contributors. 20 GB storage, 250 automations per month, Gantt (no timeline view). Only available to new customers.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Per Member per month; minimum 3 Members, unlimited Guests and Contributors. 1 TB storage, unlimited automations, timeline view, workload tracking, connect to external AI tools.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; 10+ Members. Unlimited storage, SAML-based SSO, directory integrations, enterprise access controls; HIPAA BAA available.

plans.name: Advanced Work Management
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Enterprise plus Advanced Portfolios, Dynamic View, Data Shuttle, Connectors, DataMesh, Pivot App, Premium Support.

integrations: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Slack on all plans; Power BI, Tableau, Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and Gemini Enterprise from Business; nearly 100 more
support: Standard Support Package (add-on on Business, included on Enterprise)
Premium Support Package (add-on; included in Advanced Work Management)

name: Teamwork.com
tagline: Project management and professional services automation for client work, with time tracking, budgets and AI agents.
bestFor: Agencies and client-services teams that bill for their time
description: Teamwork.com manages client projects with Gantt, table, list and board views, time tracking, budgets, invoicing, resource planning and automations, plus built-in AI agents. A free plan covers up to 5 users, and Basics costs $9.99 per user per month billed yearly or $13.99 monthly.
pros: Every paid plan includes a monthly AI credit allowance (1,000 on Basics, 2,500 on Accelerate, 7,500 on Optimize)
Billable vs non-billable time tracking on every plan, including Free
Client users can be invited into projects from Basics
US or EU data hosting and SOC 2 compliance on every plan
cons: Minimum of 3 users on Basics and 5 on Accelerate
Timesheets, time budgets and invoicing start on Accelerate ($24.99 per user per month yearly)
Free plan is limited to 5 users, 5 projects and 100 MB of storage
freePlanDetails: Up to 5 users and 5 projects, 100 MB storage, 100 automations, 2 project templates, Gantt/table/list/board views, billable vs non-billable time tracking. No credit card required.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Max 5 users, 5 projects, 100 MB storage, 100 automations.

plans.name: Basics
plans.notes: Per user per month; minimum 3 users. 300 projects, 100 GB storage, 5,000 automations, 1,000 AI credits per month (shared), AI agents Scout and Flo. No timesheets.

plans.name: Accelerate
plans.notes: Per user per month; minimum 5 users. 600 projects, 250 GB storage, 20,000 automations, 2,500 AI credits per month, timesheets, time budgets, workload planning, basic invoices.

plans.name: Optimize
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited projects, 500 GB storage, 100,000 automations, 7,500 AI credits per month, timesheet approvals, quotes, multi-currency.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited projects, 1,000 GB storage, 100,000 automations, custom AI credits, Premium Support with one-hour-or-less response.

integrations: MCP server for connecting LLMs on all plans; accounting, CRM and chat integrations
